notes: λόγον is rendered positively as 'a word', so nothing is available to carry the negation alone and οὐκ keeps 'not' as an ordinary aligned unit (rule 69's reasoning).
ὄπισθεν is an improper preposition rendered by a single English word, so rule 71's frame question does not arise and the head is that word; the governed genitive stands bare under rule 101.
